scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs/promises').then(({rm}) => rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.verify:code-download: npm run build && npm run validate:build && npm run audit:release && node scripts/sync-code-download-builds.js --verify
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run validate:build
scripts.verify:release: npm run check && npm run audit:release && node scripts/sync-code-download-builds.js --verify
scripts.package:release: npm run build && npm run validate:build && npm run audit:release && node scripts/sync-code-download-builds.js --verify && node scripts/package-release.js
scripts.verify:distribution: npm run verify:release && npm run package:release && npm run verify:packages
